classDiagram
    class AppSettings {
        window WindowSettings
        projects ProjectSettings[]
        lastActiveProjectId string
        ruleTemplates RuleTemplate[]
    }
    class RuleTemplate {
        id string
        name string
        enabled bool
        intend RuleIntend
        hook RuleHook
        prompt string
        createdAt string
        updatedAt string
    }
    class Rule {
        id number
        name string
        enabled bool
        intend RuleIntend
        hook RuleHook
        prompt string
    }
    AppSettings "1" *-- "0..*" RuleTemplate : stores
    RuleTemplate ..> Rule : creates project copy
